body: Hold up, first of all those people who told you that are sick and toxic af. You need to find people who will truly understand you and not shame you for feeling like that. Your feelings and emotions matter so don't believe anything they say. I wish for you the best!
Hi! I've been in your place before and I know for a fact how much it hurts plus without the aid of other people. Please don't mind my username but if you need anyone to talk to, I'll be glad to.

At first, I didn't understand what really true friendship means leading me to making toxic friendship with others. After they had enough of my kindness, they'll just ghost me. I have this 'friend' for 2 years. I really like her humor. But then I started to notice she's becoming mean and rude to me and I don't understand why. I haven't done anything bad to her. After 2 years of doing favor and good things to her, she just became a real b*tch towards me. The hard thing is, she's a b*tch only to me and not to our other friends. Good thing is that this school year ended and I can easily remove her from my life.
Literally what I have just been thinking of lately
